SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.separator

Class SeparatorEfficiencyReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.separator.SeparatorEfficiencyReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SeparatorEfficiencyReport extends Object implements Serializable
Aggregated separation-efficiency report for a complete separator or gas scrubber.

Combines the physics-based entrainment / carry-under fractions computed by the SeparatorPerformanceCalculator with a per-internal K-factor operating-window assessment (from InternalOperatingWindow). The report answers two questions:

  1. What is the separation efficiency of the vessel (gas-liquid and, for three-phase, liquid-liquid) given how the internals are configured?
  2. Is each internal (mist mat, vane pack, cyclone deck) operating inside its recommended K-factor window, or is it below turndown or into flooding?

The report is produced on demand by SeparatorMechanicalDesign.calculateSeparationEfficiency() and does not alter the separator run-time behaviour. Whether the physics model is applied during run() is controlled separately by the detailed-entrainment toggle.

1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • computeVerdict

      public void computeVerdict()
      Computes the overall verdict from the internal operating windows and the overall gas-liquid efficiency.

      Flooding of any internal dominates, followed by below-turndown operation; otherwise the verdict is driven by the overall gas-liquid efficiency against goodEfficiencyThreshold.
